configurations.//: MUST run from inside dashboard/. wrangler resolves the functions directory against the WORKING directory, not the assets path - so `pages dev dashboard/public` from the repo root serves the site with no API and every /api/* route returns the SPA's HTML. Same trap as the deploy one in DEV-HANDOVER.md.
configurations.name: mary-hub
runtimeArgs: cd dashboard && npx wrangler pages dev public --port 8788 --d1 DB=mary-dashboard-db --persist-to=.wrangler/state
